preconditions.description: The number of queries q must be between 1 and 100.
The number of elements in array A must be between 1 and 50.
The sum of elements in array A must be between 0 and 200.
The sum of absolute differences between each pair of elements must be between 0 and 2000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or all(isinstance(x, int) and x >= 0 for x in map(int, stdout.split()))
postconditions.description: The output must either be -1 or a space-separated list of non-negative integers.
The sum of the elements in the output array must equal s.

postconditions.expression: sum(abs(a - b) for a, b in itertools.combinations(map(int, stdout.split()), 2)) == k
postconditions.description: The sum of absolute differences between each pair of elements in the output array must equal k.
